title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: In an OLS model, the matrix $X$ represents the design matrix, which includes all the features and the intercept term. The number of rows in $X$ corresponds to the number of observations, $n$, and the number of columns corresponds to the number of features plus one (for the intercept), $p+1$.

title: Matrix $X$ Dimensions
text: The matrix $X$ should have dimensions $n$ by $p+1$. This means that for each observation, there is a row in the matrix, and for each feature (including the intercept), there is a column.

title: Checking Matrix Dimensions
text: Given that $X$ has $n$ observations and $p+1$ features, what should be the dimensions of $X$?

title: True or False?
text: Based on the understanding of matrix dimensions in OLS, determine if the statement about the dimensions of $X$ being $n$ by $p+1$ is true or false.
